title: Where do decisions go, and when do they stop? Many vanished once principles were reviewed (2026-10-28)

sections.name: narrative

sections.content:
Now I want you to add what might be a parallel section to the programme.

Where do decisions go? When do they stop?
Many of the decisions I've had to review just needed me to prompt a review of principles - and they vanished.
